findings.title: RSA
findings.description: Quantum-vulnerable algorithm RSA: broken by Shor's algorithm on a cryptographically-relevant quantum computer (nistQuantumSecurityLevel 0). NIST deprecates RSA/ECC/DH after 2030 and disallows them from 2035 (NIST SP 1800-38 / IR 8547); CNSA 2.0 NSS milestones: software/firmware signing 2025, networking 2030, all NSS by 2033-2035; migrate to ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) / ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) (target family ML-KEM (FIPS 203) / ML-DSA (FIPS 204)).; Insecure RSA encryption padding on RSA: PKCS#1 v1.5 (or textbook/raw) RSA encryption is a chosen-ciphertext / padding-oracle break (Bleichenbacher, ROBOT; CWE-780). Use RSA-OAEP for encryption, or a hybrid KEM (ML-KEM / ECIES). Note: PKCS#1 v1.5 *signatures* remain FIPS 186-5-approved and are not flagged.
findings.suggested_fix: Plan migration to post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM (FIPS 203) / ML-DSA (FIPS 204)); NIST deprecates quantum-vulnerable public-key cryptography after 2030 and disallows it after 2035.
